scope: Separate prospectively registered production form-submission study, independent of the 4.2.3 release smoke.
learner: There are two blue socks and one yellow sock in a drawer. I’m going to draw one at random without looking. I’d like to guess which colour I’m more likely to pick before you explain.
firstAction: Send the synthetic prompt once in a fresh anonymous production classroom. Capture viewport, measured Question coordinates and a separate legend-centered image.
followUp: On an authentic eligible Question about the most-likely colour, submit Blue exactly once using the form. Observe any naturally chosen grading and response; report pending or withheld outcomes.
authorizedIntervention: Limit only the normal real tutor max_completion_tokens / max_tokens parameter to 8192. All conversation, choices, tools and decision prompts retain actual app values.
streamEvidence: Bounded independent reader on a clone of the same streaming response; no stream replay. Keep up to 2 MiB and retain only returned IDs/usage.
subjects: Synthetic anonymous browser only. No real account entry, human learning outcomes or hidden quiz score inference.
